item.title: Alvin Kamara: Cleared from injury report
item.description:
Kamara (back) was limited at Friday's practice but does not have an injury designation for Week 7, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

item.title: Rico Dowdle: Questionable for Week 7
item.description:

item.title: Puka Nacua: Seemingly avoids serious setback
item.description:
The calf injury Nacua sustained Thursday is believed to be "more minor than anything else" and "not significant," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

item.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Minimal role in Week 7 loss
item.description:
Henderson rushed three times for nine yards and secured both targets for 14 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

item.title: Hunter Henry: Busy night in Week 7 loss
item.description:
